sloka: स मुहूर्तमनुध्याय बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।बभूव संरब्धतरो युगान्त इव पावकः ।। ६.१०१.३८ ।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtamanudhyāya bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ।babhūva saṁrabdhataro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.101.38 ।।

translations.english: He (Raghava) stood confused for a short while as it was, his eyes filled with tears like fire at the end of the universe.
